name: USC Viterbi Energy of STEM Summer Camp (free)
what_you_do: A free one-week summer camp with demos, hands-on projects and group work. Topics are physics, coding, energy and electronics. SoCalGas employees lead activities with USC staff and students.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 8 to 11 in 2026, rising grades 9 to 12. Active MESA, Mission Science and Engineering Transformer students come first. So do students at STEM Center schools. All students are considered.
deadline_text: The 2026 application closed May 4, 2026 and applicants were told by the end of May. The 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: When it is open, send a student form and a teacher recommendation. You can use the online form or the PDF. Forms that are not complete are not considered. Contact k12summer@usc.edu.
notes: The program page says in person at USC main campus. The USC Viterbi summer programs list calls it virtual. Confirm the format before you count on it.
